dialogues.jp: 「ゲームでいいんじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "How about a game?"
dialogues.text: "How about a game?"

dialogues.jp:
貰って嬉しくない奴なんて、そうそういないだ
ろうし。
dialogues.en: I know that most guys would be happy with that.
dialogues.text: I know that most guys would be happy with that.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ゲームね……まあ、無難といえば無難かな」
dialogues.en: "A game, huh......? I guess that's a safe choice."
dialogues.text: "A game, huh......? I guess that's a safe choice."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、ゲームで決定ですね」
dialogues.en: "So shall we get a game?"
dialogues.text: "So shall we get a game?"

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の笑顔で、俺の提案が採用される。
dialogues.en: My suggestion was accepted with Moe-sempai's smile.
dialogues.text: My suggestion was accepted with Moe-sempai's smile.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ眞子ちゃん、買いにいきましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go get it, Mako-chan."
dialogues.text: "Let's go get it, Mako-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん……ねえ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... Hey, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... Hey, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
ふたりを見送るつもりでいた俺は、『じゃあな』
という言葉を飲み込んで眞子に目を向ける。
dialogues.en:
I was getting ready to see them off, but I looked at Mako as
she spoke at me.
dialogues.text:
I was getting ready to see them off, but I looked at Mako as
she spoke at me.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「一緒にお店に来てよ」
dialogues.en: "Can you come to the store with us?"
dialogues.text: "Can you come to the store with us?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「んっ？　なんで俺が？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Why me?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Why me?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「どれがいいか、あたしたちじゃ分かんないし。
　ね、お姉ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "We wouldn't know which one to get. Right, oneechan?"
dialogues.text: "We wouldn't know which one to get. Right, oneechan?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、何を買ったらいいのか、わかり
　ませんね」
dialogues.en: "That's true. We don't know which one to get."
dialogues.text: "That's true. We don't know which one to get."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ね、そういうことだから、お願い」
dialogues.en: "See? Please!"
dialogues.text: "See? Please!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ、洋服とかもいいんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "You know what? How about getting him some clothes?"
dialogues.text: "You know what? How about getting him some clothes?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ゲーム」
dialogues.en: "No, we want a game."
dialogues.text: "No, we want a game."

dialogues.jp:
もっとふたりが選びやすいものにすればよかっ
た。
dialogues.en: I should've suggested something that they could choose.
dialogues.text: I should've suggested something that they could choose.

dialogues.jp: 後悔、先に立たず。
dialogues.en: What a pain.
dialogues.text: What a pain.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「私、ゲーム屋さんって初めてです」
dialogues.en: "I've never been to the game store."
dialogues.text: "I've never been to the game store."

dialogues.jp:
にこにこ笑顔の萌先輩に駄目押しをされ、ふた
りを連れてゲーム店に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't resist Moe-sempai's smile, and I headed toward
the game store with the two of them.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't resist Moe-sempai's smile, and I headed toward
the game store with the two of them.

dialogues.jp: はぁ……。
dialogues.en: Good grief......
dialogues.text: Good grief......

dialogues.jp: ◆ゲームでしょ◆
dialogues.en: ◆How about a game?◆
dialogues.text: ◆How about a game?◆

dialogues.jp:
ゲーム辺りが無難なところだろう。俺は、そう
答えた。
dialogues.en: I told them that the game would be a safe choice.
dialogues.text: I told them that the game would be a safe choice.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、ゲームには｛うと／疎｝い二人の事、プレゼント
探しに俺までかり出される事になった。かった
る……。
dialogues.en:
However, they aren't familiar with games, and I wound up
taking them to the game store. What a pain...
dialogues.text:
However, they aren't familiar with games, and I wound up
taking them to the game store. What a pain...
